title: Ownership (Part 4) - String slices
learning_objectives: Use `&str` slices to view part of a string without copying.
Return a borrowed substring from a helper function.
Explain why the returned slice must point at the original input.
explanation: This slice narrows ownership down to borrowed string ranges. A string slice lets a function hand back part of the original text without allocating a new `String`, as long as the returned view still points into the caller's input.

examples.title: Return the first word as a slice
Keep using the original string after slicing

compiler_error_examples: error[E0515]: cannot return value referencing local variable
completion_criteria: Exercise tests pass by returning borrowed views for spaced and unspaced text
Learner can describe why a string slice borrows from the original input instead of owning new data
